correlation_rules.WTI_and_Brent: one GLOBAL_CRUDE family, never two independent votes
correlation_rules.USDINR: translation modifier only; cannot independently create or reverse direction
correlation_rules.event_news: directional only with explicit point-in-time stance plus price/reaction confirmation
correlation_rules.memory: future underlying returns only; no entry, stop, target, R multiple or option PnL

direction_rule: At least two independent directional families must align and no independent family may oppose them.

confidence_rule.MODERATE: exactly two aligned independent directional families
confidence_rule.STRONG: at least three aligned independent directional families
confidence_rule.CONFLICTED: at least one bullish and one bearish independent directional family
confidence_rule.WEAK: fewer than two aligned independent directional families

direction_memory_rule.analogue_selection: market-state similarity only; outcome sign inspected only after neighbour selection

primary_question: Does the frozen V2 shadow thesis improve 60-minute CRUDEOILM directional discrimination on untouched data?
secondary_questions: Does V2 improve persistence discrimination across 15/30/60/120 minutes?
Which independent evidence families add stable out-of-sample information without becoming correlated duplicate votes?
After direction is validated, can a separately preregistered Entry Brain improve timing without changing the Direction Brain?
